goal: Add Cloudflare Clef as a second System One decision backend for the two TypeSafe rungs (tier 0c name select, category select) and let the eval harnesses score Jev, hosted Clef and a local Clef server side by side. Default behaviour stays byte-identical (Jev, or nothing when keyless); switching production is a later human decision made from the eval numbers.
rules: Project rules live in CLAUDE.md at the repo root: read its sections on .env keys, tests and naming before editing. Run the suite with: PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 ./.venv/bin/python smoke_test.py (macOS path; never the system python). Any new env var that can reach a network or a bill is set to "" (never popped) at the top of smoke_test.py and tools/*_eval.py. No test may make a real network call to api.typesafe.ai or api.cloudflare.com. User-visible strings exist in all 5 locales or not at all.

work_packages.title: Decision backend seam: ig_places/decision.py (Jev | Clef on Workers AI)
work_packages.goal: One module that decides which System One backend the TypeSafe rungs talk to, and builds the SDK client for it.
acceptance: DECISION_BACKEND unset/blank/'jev' -> exactly today's TypeSafeClient (same model, timeout, retry); keyless stays disabled
DECISION_BACKEND='clef' -> TypeSafeClient over a custom httpx2 transport that POSTs to Cloudflare Workers AI and unwraps the {result: ...} envelope
Unknown DECISION_BACKEND value -> enabled() is False (fail closed), never falls back to another backend
aicost prices for clef and clef-flash
smoke_test blanks the new env vars at the top and has checks for all of the above with a fake inner transport; zero real network

work_packages.title: Wire typesafe_select and typesafe_category through decision.py
work_packages.goal: Both production rungs get their client, model name and enabled() gate from decision.py; nothing else about them changes.
acceptance: Keyless and default-backend behaviour byte-identical (existing tier 0c / category checks pass unchanged)
Trail steps and aicost.record carry the active backend's pinned model (clef-flash when DECISION_BACKEND=clef)
typesafe_select.MODEL stays 'jev-1.13.0' (the eval harness and video_eval import it)
_no_typesafe guard still intercepts every request on both backends

work_packages.title: Eval harnesses: --backend jev|clef|local with per-backend cache and latency
work_packages.goal: tools/typesafe_eval.py and tools/category_eval.py can score the same gold set on Jev, hosted Clef, or a local Clef server, without ever mixing their cached answers.
acceptance: --backend local --base-url http://127.0.0.1:8000 runs free (no --spend-real-money, no key) and refuses any non-loopback URL
jev and clef stay behind --spend-real-money; TYPESAFE_BASE_URL stays blanked at import
Cache key includes backend and model; a local answer can never satisfy a Jev lookup or vice versa
Per-row latency recorded; p50/p95 printed per backend

work_packages.title: Docs and disclosure: naming architecture, credentials, privacy processor list
work_packages.goal: Every place that documents or discloses the TypeSafe rungs also describes the Clef backend, accurately and with no claim that it is live.
acceptance: NAMING_ARCHITECTURE Tier 0c and category sections describe DECISION_BACKEND, gates, pricing and the per-backend eval
CREDENTIALS.md has rows for CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID / CLOUDFLARE_AI_TOKEN (expiry, rotation, where to get it)
privacy.html processor list names Cloudflare Workers AI beside TypeSafe for candidate/category choice, both languages on the page
Compliance notes record Cloudflare as a new processor of caption text and the no-retention / no-training statement
